script: セイバールート六日目-14
title: セイバールート六日目-14

pages.ja:
切っ先が交差する。
幾度にも振るわれる剣線、
幾重もの太刀筋。
弾け、火花を散らしあう剣と刀。
pages.jaRuby:
切っ先が交差する。
幾度にも振るわれる剣線、
幾重もの太刀筋。
弾け、火花を散らしあう剣と刀。
pages.en:
Their points cross.

Stroke follows stroke, blade tracing over blade.

Sword and katana collide, spring apart, and shower one another with sparks.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The points of the swords cross.
The swords are swung many times.
Numerous blows.
The sword and the katana repel each other, scattering sparks.

pages.ja:
数十合を越える立ち会いは、しかし、一向に両者の立場を変動させない。
上段に位置したアサシンは一歩も引く事なく、
石段を駆け上がろうとするセイバーは一歩も詰め寄る事が出来ず、徒に時間と気力を削っていた。
pages.jaRuby:
数十合を越える立ち会いは、しかし、一向に両者の立場を変動させない。
上段に位置したアサシンは一歩も引く事なく、
石段を駆け上がろうとするセイバーは一歩も詰め寄る事が出来ず、[ruby text=いたずら]徒に時間と気力を削っていた。
pages.en:
—They have exchanged dozens of blows, yet neither one's position has changed in the slightest.

Above, Assassin has not yielded a single step.

Below, Saber cannot advance a single step up the stone stairs. She only wastes time and wears down her resolve.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The session of more than a few dozen blows does not change the positions of the two.
Assassin, positioned above, does not retreat even a step,
and Saber, trying to ascend the stairs, is unable to draw nearer and uselessly wastes time and spirit.

pages.ja:
「は
！」
数十回目となるセイバーの踏み込み。
五尺余もの長刀を苦もなく振るい、セイバーの進撃を防ぎきるアサシン。
pages.jaRuby:
「は
！」
数十回目となるセイバーの踏み込み。
五尺余もの長刀を苦もなく振るい、セイバーの進撃を防ぎきるアサシン。
pages.en:
“Hah—!”

Saber surges forward yet again—the latest of dozens of charges.

Assassin wields a blade more than five feet long without the slightest effort, turning back her every advance.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haa!”
Saber rushes in again.
Assassin swings his longsword without difficulty and defends completely against Saber’s charge.

pages.ja:
いや、それは防ぎきる、などという生易しいものではない。
セイバーの剣戟が稲妻ならば、アサシンの長刀は疾風だった。
速さ、重さではセイバーに及ばないものの、しなやかな軌跡はセイバーの一撃を悉く受け流す。
そうして返される刃は速度を増し、突風となってセイバーの首に翻る。
pages.jaRuby:
いや、それは防ぎきる、などという生易しいものではない。
セイバーの剣戟が稲妻ならば、アサシンの長刀は疾風だった。
速さ、重さではセイバーに及ばないものの、しなやかな軌跡はセイバーの一撃を[ruby text=ことごと]悉く受け流す。
そうして返される刃は速度を増し、突風となってセイバーの首に[ruby text=ひるがえ]翻る。
pages.en:
No—“turning back” is far too mild a phrase.

If Saber's sword is lightning, Assassin's long blade is the gale.

It cannot equal her in speed or weight, yet its supple path carries every one of her blows aside.

The returning edge gathers speed and whips like a gust toward Saber's neck.
pages.mirrorMoon:
No, it isn’t as simple as defending.
If Saber’s sword is lightning, Assassin’s sword is a hurricane.
Even though it does not match Saber in speed or power, its elastic tracks parry Saber’s every blow.
And the counter increases speed and flows toward Saber’s neck like a strong wind.

pages.ja:
その一撃を紙一重で躱して踏み込むセイバーへ、躱した筈の長刀が間髪入れずに返ってくるのだ。
直線的なセイバーの剣筋に対し、アサシンの剣筋は曲線を描く。
アサシンの切っ先は優雅ではあるが、弧を描く為に最短距離ではない。
ならば直線であるセイバーの剣筋に間に合う筈がないというのに、その差を無にするだけの何かがアサシンにはあった。
pages.jaRuby:
その一撃を紙一重で[ruby text=かわ]躱して踏み込むセイバーへ、[ruby text=かわ]躱した筈の長刀が間髪入れずに返ってくるのだ。
直線的なセイバーの剣筋に対し、アサシンの剣筋は曲線を描く。
アサシンの切っ先は優雅ではあるが、弧を描く為に最短距離ではない。
ならば直線であるセイバーの剣筋に間に合う筈がないというのに、その差を[ruby text=ゼロ]無にするだけの何かがアサシンにはあった。
pages.en:
—She slips past it by a hair's breadth and steps forward. Yet the long blade she thought she had escaped reverses without pause and comes for her again.

Saber's strokes travel in straight lines; Assassin's describe curves.

His point moves elegantly, but an arc cannot take the shortest path. It should never arrive in time to answer Saber's direct attack.

Yet Assassin possesses something that erases the difference—reduces it to zero.
pages.mirrorMoon:
When Saber steps in again after avoiding that attack, the sword she has avoided comes at her again in no time.
In contrast to the straight path Saber’s sword takes, Assassin’s sword takes a curved path.
Assassin’s blade is graceful, but since it moves in an arc, it does not take the shortest route.
So he shouldn’t be able to make it in time against Saber’s sword moving in a straight line, but there is something about Assassin that reduces that difference to zero.

pages.ja:
「くっ
！」
踏み込む足が止まる。
切り返す長刀に剣が間に合わない。
避ける為には引くしかない、と咄嗟に後退する。
pages.jaRuby:
「くっ
！」
踏み込む足が止まる。
切り返す長刀に剣が間に合わない。
避ける為には引くしかない、と咄嗟に後退する。
pages.en:
“Kh—!”

Her advancing foot stops.

Her sword cannot meet the returning blade in time.

With retreat her only means of escape, she springs backward.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Kuh!”
The charge stops.
Her sword won’t make it in time against his sword’s counter-attack.
She steps back, knowing the only way she can avoid it is to retreat.

pages.ja:
見惚れるほど美しいアサシンの剣筋は、同時に、見届ける事が困難なほどの速度だった。
その矛盾はアサシンの技量によるものなのか、頭上の敵に挑む己の不利な状況ゆえなのか。
確たる分析もつかないまま、追撃してくるアサシンの長刀を避け、首を突きに来る切っ先を剣で弾く。
pages.jaRuby:
見惚れるほど美しいアサシンの剣筋は、同時に、見届ける事が困難なほどの速度だった。
その矛盾はアサシンの技量によるものなのか、頭上の敵に挑む己の不利な状況ゆえなのか。
確たる分析もつかないまま、追撃してくるアサシンの長刀を避け、首を突きに来る切っ先を剣で弾く。
pages.en:
Assassin's swordsmanship is beautiful enough to entrance the eye and fast enough to escape it.

Does that contradiction arise from his mastery, or from her own disadvantage in challenging an enemy above her?

Unable to reach a firm conclusion, she evades the pursuing blade and knocks aside the point thrusting for her throat.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Assassin’s swordplay is fascinatingly beautiful. But at the same time, it is so fast that it is hard to follow.
Is that contradiction because of Assassin’s skill or the unfavorable position of attacking someone on higher ground?
Without a definite answer, she avoids the sword pursuing her and parries the point trying to pierce her neck.

pages.ja:
「っ
」
気が付けば、さらに数段後退している。
あれほどの長刀だ。
一度捌いてしまえば懐に入るのは容易いというのに、どうしてもそれができない。
pages.jaRuby:
「っ
」
気が付けば、さらに数段後退している。
あれほどの長刀だ。
一度捌いてしまえば懐に入るのは容易いというのに、どうしてもそれができない。
pages.en:
“——”

Before she realizes it, she has retreated several steps farther.

His blade is extraordinarily long.

Once she has parried it, entering inside its reach should be easy. Yet no matter what she tries, she cannot.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
When she notices, she has retreated a few more steps.
It’s such a long sword.
It should be easy to go inside on him once she has parried it away once, but she somehow cannot manage to do so.

pages.ja:
卓越した敵の技量と、絶対的に不利な足場。
ここが平地であったのなら、あの長刀にこれほど苦戦する事もない、とセイバーは唇を噛む。
pages.jaRuby:
卓越した敵の技量と、絶対的に不利な足場。
ここが平地であったのなら、あの長刀にこれほど苦戦する事もない、とセイバーは唇を噛む。
pages.en:
Peerless skill and absolutely unfavorable ground.

On level footing, that long blade could never trouble her so badly. Saber bites her lip.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The enemy’s excellent skill and the definitely disadvantageous ground.
Saber bites her lips, thinking she would not have this much trouble with that longsword on flat ground.

pages.ja:
「
さすがにやりにくいな。視えない剣というものがこれほど厄介とは思わなんだ」
アサシンは不動である。
彼にとって、これは守りの戦いにすぎない。
後退するセイバーを無理に追撃する必要もなし、上に位置するという有利を捨てる筈がない。
pages.jaRuby:
「
さすがにやりにくいな。視えない剣というものがこれほど厄介とは思わなんだ」
アサシンは不動である。
彼にとって、これは守りの戦いにすぎない。
後退するセイバーを無理に追撃する必要もなし、上に位置するという有利を捨てる筈がない。
pages.en:
“—This is difficult indeed. I never imagined an invisible sword could prove so troublesome.”

Assassin remains motionless.

For him, this is only a defensive engagement. He has no reason to pursue Saber when she retreats, still less to surrender the advantage of higher ground.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It is indeed hard to fight against. I did not imagine an invisible sword would be this troublesome.”
Assassin does not move.
For him, this is only a battle of defense.
He has no need to chase the retreating Saber without reason nor forsake his advantage of higher ground.

pages.ja:
「……ふむ。見れば刀を見る事さえ初めてであろう？
私の剣筋は邪道でな、並の者ならばまず一撃で首を落とす。それをここまで防ぐとは、嬉しいぞセイバー」
pages.jaRuby:
「……ふむ。見れば刀を見る事さえ初めてであろう？
私の剣筋は邪道でな、並の者ならばまず一撃で首を落とす。それをここまで防ぐとは、嬉しいぞセイバー」
pages.en:
“…Hmm. From the look of you, this is your first encounter with a katana, is it not?

“My style is unorthodox. An ordinary opponent would have lost their head to the first stroke. I am pleased that you have defended yourself so long, Saber.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Hmm. I believe this is the first time you’ve even seen a katana, is it not?
My sword is a heresy, and it will slice the head of one of average skill. I am happy you have blocked this much, Saber.”

pages.ja:
「加えて、打ち込みも素晴らしい。その小躯でこれほどの剣戟を行うからには、さぞ鍛え抜かれた全身であろう」
追撃する必要がない為か、アサシンは余裕げにセイバーを観察する。
pages.jaRuby:
「加えて、打ち込みも素晴らしい。その小躯でこれほどの剣戟を行うからには、さぞ鍛え抜かれた全身であろう」
追撃する必要がない為か、アサシンは余裕げにセイバーを観察する。
pages.en:
“Your own blows are magnificent. To deliver such strikes from so slight a frame, your entire body must be tempered beyond measure.”

Having no need to press the attack, Assassin observes Saber at his leisure.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“And on top of that, your drive is marvelous. You are able to do so much with that small body of yours. Your body must indeed be well-trained.”
As he has no need to keep attacking, Assassin observes Saber calmly.

pages.ja:
力を失い、ゆらぐ切っ先。
それを隙と見て踏み込む事など出来ない。
あの男には構えなどないのだ。
いかなる体勢からでも刀を振るえないようでは、あれほどの長刀は扱えまい。
pages.jaRuby:
力を失い、ゆらぐ切っ先。
それを隙と見て踏み込む事など出来ない。
あの男には構えなどないのだ。
いかなる体勢からでも刀を振るえないようでは、あれほどの長刀は扱えまい。
pages.en:
The strength leaves his point, and it wavers.

She cannot mistake that for an opening and rush in.

The man has no stance.

Unless he could swing from any posture, he could never wield a blade of such length.
pages.mirrorMoon:
His sword wavers, losing strength.
She cannot charge as if that is an opening.
There are no stances for that man.
He can only use that long a sword if he can swing it from any position.

pages.ja:
「どうした？ これで終わりという訳ではあるまい。その不可視の剣、見かけ倒しではなかろうに」
「ふん、いつまでも減らず口を
！」
pages.jaRuby:
「どうした？ これで終わりという訳ではあるまい。その不可視の剣、見かけ倒しではなかろうに」
「ふん、いつまでも減らず口を
！」
pages.en:
“What is wrong? Surely this is not the end. That unseen sword cannot be all show and no substance.”

“Hmph. You never tire of running your mouth—!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“What? It cannot be that this is the end. That invisible sword is not just mere show, is it not?”
“Hah, quit your impudent talk!”

pages.ja:
激突する剣と刀。
「
いよし、当たりだ……！」
ぎぃん、と何もない空中で止まる長刀。
アサシンは視えない剣を止めた刀をにやりと見つめ、そのまま剣を受け流し
セイバーは、首を払いに来る一閃を受けきった。
pages.jaRuby:
激突する剣と刀。
「
いよし、当たりだ……！」
ぎぃん、と何もない空中で止まる長刀。
アサシンは視えない剣を止めた刀をにやりと見つめ、そのまま剣を受け流し
セイバーは、首を払いに来る一閃を受けきった。
pages.en:
Sword and katana collide.

“—Good. There it is…!”

With a metallic shriek, the long blade stops in empty air.

Assassin smiles at the katana that has caught the unseen sword. In the same motion, he sends Saber's blade sliding aside—

And Saber catches the flash of steel sweeping for her neck.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The sword and the katana crash.
“All right, I am correct…!”
The longsword stops in empty space.
Assassin smiles and looks at his sword blocking the invisible sword, parries her sword, and
Saber defends herself from the blow to her neck.

pages.ja:
「っ……！」
セイバーとて判っている。
今まで見慣れないアサシンの剣戟を防げたのは、偏にこの剣のおかげなのだと。
不可視の剣は攻め込むにも受けに回るにも、相手の感覚を狂わせる。
pages.jaRuby:
「っ……！」
セイバーとて判っている。
今まで見慣れないアサシンの剣戟を防げたのは、偏にこの剣のおかげなのだと。
不可視の剣は攻め込むにも受けに回るにも、相手の感覚を狂わせる。
pages.en:
“——!”

Saber understands perfectly well.

She has defended herself against Assassin's unfamiliar swordsmanship only because of the weapon she holds.

Whether she attacks or defends, an invisible blade confounds her opponent's senses.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……!”
Even Saber knows.
That it is because of her invisible sword that she is able to block Assassin’s unfamiliar techniques.
The invisible sword confuses the opponent’s senses in both offense and defense.

pages.ja:
故にアサシンは深く追撃をしない。
セイバーの武器の長さが判らない以上、アサシンから攻め込むのは危険すぎる。
アサシンがセイバーを仕留めにかかる時があるとすれば、それは
pages.jaRuby:

セイバーの武器の長さが判らない以上、アサシンから攻め込むのは危険すぎる。
アサシンがセイバーを仕留めにかかる時があるとすれば、それは
pages.en:
That is why Assassin never presses his pursuit.

So long as he does not know the length of Saber's weapon, initiating an attack is too dangerous.

If he ever commits himself to killing her, it will be when—
pages.mirrorMoon:
That is why Assassin does not follow through too much.
As he does not know how long Saber’s sword is, it is too dangerous for Assassin to close in on Saber.
If Assassin ever goes to attack Saber, that will be when

pages.ja:
「ハッ…………！」
アサシンの額をうち砕きにかかるセイバー。
その一撃を、
アサシンはわずかに後退しただけで、完全に躱しきった。
pages.jaRuby:
「ハッ…………！」
アサシンの額をうち砕きにかかるセイバー。
その一撃を、
アサシンはわずかに後退しただけで、完全に躱しきった。
pages.en:
“Hah…………!”

Saber drives her blade toward Assassin's brow.

He evades the stroke completely with one slight step backward.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hah…!”
Saber tries to smash Assassin’s head.
That blow…
…Is perfectly dodged by Assassin, who merely retreats a bit.

pages.ja:
「……よし、これで目測はついたな。刀身三尺余、幅は四寸といったところか。形状は……ふむ、セイバーの名の通り、典型的な西洋の剣だな」
涼しげに語るものの、それがどれほど卓絶した目利きなのか言うまでもない。
セイバーの一撃は、たとえ剣が見えていようと捉える事が困難な速さなのだ。
にも関わらず、視えない剣を防ぎきり、かつ全容すら把握するとは
pages.jaRuby:
「……よし、これで目測はついたな。刀身三尺余、幅は四寸といったところか。形状は……ふむ、セイバーの名の通り、典型的な西洋の剣だな」
涼しげに語るものの、それがどれほど卓絶した目利きなのか言うまでもない。
セイバーの一撃は、たとえ剣が見えていようと捉える事が困難な速さなのだ。
にも関わらず、視えない剣を防ぎきり、かつ全容すら把握するとは
pages.en:
“…Good. I can judge it now. A blade slightly over three feet long, perhaps four inches wide. Its shape… hmm. True to the name Saber, a typical Western sword.”

His voice remains cool, though the discernment he has just displayed is nothing short of extraordinary.

Even when visible, Saber's attack is too fast for the eye to follow. Yet he has defended against an invisible sword and discerned its entire shape and dimensions—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…All right, I see it now. The blade is roughly three Shaku (ninety centimeters) long and four sun (twelve centimeters) wide. The shape is… hmmm… like your name, Saber, it is a typical western sword.”
He talks calmly but it does not even need to be said how good his judgment is.
Saber’s blows are too fast to perceive even if the sword can be seen.
But not only does he defend against the invisible sword, but he has figured out its shape

pages.ja: 「……信じられない。何の魔術も使わず、満足に打ち合ってもいないというのに私の剣を計ったのですか、貴方は」
pages.jaRuby: 「……信じられない。何の魔術も使わず、満足に打ち合ってもいないというのに私の剣を計ったのですか、貴方は」
pages.en: “…Impossible. Without using magecraft, without ever properly crossing blades with me—you measured my sword?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “I cannot believe it. You have measured my sword without using any magic nor exchanging blows with me.”

pages.ja: 「ほう、驚いたか？ だがこんなものは大道芸であろうよ。邪剣使い故、このような技ばかり上手くなる」
pages.jaRuby: 「ほう、驚いたか？ だがこんなものは大道芸であろうよ。邪剣使い故、このような技ばかり上手くなる」
pages.en: “Oh? Have I surprised you? This is no more than a street performer's trick. When one wields a heretical sword, these are the sorts of tricks one learns.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Oh, are you surprised? But this is just a street performance. As I am an unorthodox sword-user, I only improve on such techniques.”

pages.ja:
「
なるほど。私の一撃をまともに受けず、ただ払うだけが貴方の戦いだった。邪剣使いとは、その逃げ腰からきた俗称ですか」
pages.jaRuby:
「
なるほど。私の一撃をまともに受けず、ただ払うだけが貴方の戦いだった。邪剣使いとは、その逃げ腰からきた俗称ですか」
pages.en: “—I see. You have never met the full force of my blows, but merely swept each one aside. Is ‘heretical swordsman’ a name earned by that evasive style?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “I see. It was your way of fighting not to meet any of my blows, but parry them. I see the term unorthodox comes from how much of a coward you are.”

pages.ja:
「ハ
いやいや、まともに打ち合わぬ無礼は許せ。
なにしろこの長刀だ、打ち合えば折れるは必定。おぬしとしては力勝負こそが基本なのだろうが、こちらはそうはいかぬ。その剣と組み合い、力を競い合う事はできん」
pages.jaRuby:
「ハ
いやいや、まともに打ち合わぬ無礼は許せ。
なにしろこの長刀だ、打ち合えば折れるは必定。おぬしとしては力勝負こそが基本なのだろうが、こちらはそうはいかぬ。その剣と組み合い、力を競い合う事はできん」
pages.en:
“Ha—no, no. Forgive the discourtesy of refusing to cross blades in earnest.

“With a sword this long, a direct collision would certainly break it. A contest of strength may be the foundation of combat for you, but I cannot oblige. I am unable to lock blades with that sword and vie with you in power.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“HaNo, no. Forgive my rudeness in not locking blades with you.
I have this longsword. It will break if I fight off your sword. It must be your style to compete in power, but I cannot do so. I cannot lock blades with you and compete strength with you.”

pages.ja:
「
」
「もとより、刀というものはそういうものだ。
西洋の剣は、その重さと力で物を叩き切る。
だが、我らの刀は速さと技で物を断ち斬るのだ。
戦いが噛み合わぬのは道理であろう？」
pages.jaRuby:
「
」
「もとより、刀というものはそういうものだ。
西洋の剣は、その重さと力で物を叩き切る。
だが、我らの刀は速さと技で物を断ち斬るのだ。
戦いが噛み合わぬのは道理であろう？」
pages.en:
“————”

“That is the nature of a katana.

“A Western sword uses weight and strength to batter its target apart.

“Our blades sever through speed and technique.

“Is it not natural that our styles refuse to mesh?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
“The Katana is always such a sword.
Western swords cut with their weight and power.
But our blades cut with speed and technique.
It is no wonder our fighting styles are mismatched, is it not?”

pages.en:
“Still… this has begun to dull my pleasure.

“Surely the time has come, Saber. Stop hiding what you can truly do.”

“—Assassin. Do you imagine I have been holding back?”

“Do you claim otherwise? I cannot guess your purpose, but fighting as though your blade were still in its sheath is an insult. Am I so little a threat that you need not reveal your true strength?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But well… this is somewhat unentertaining.
Now is a good time, Saber. Stop hiding your true powers.”
“…Assassin, are you saying I am going easy on you?”
“Are you saying you are not? I do not know your intentions, but you are taking me lightly fighting with your sheath on. Are you telling me that I am not worthy to fight seriously?”

pages.ja:

pages.en:
“————”

“Oh? You still refuse.

“—Very well. Then our game ends here. If you mean to hold back, I shall reveal my hidden sword first.”

With that declaration, the swordsman glides down the steps until he stands level with Saber.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
“Hm. It still seems as if you will not comply with my request.
Fine, then this is it. If you are unwilling to do so, I will show you my secret technique first.”
Saying so…
The swordsman with the longsword comes down next to Saber.

pages.ja:
「な
」
アサシンにとって、頭上の有利を放棄するという事は負けに等しい。
アサシンは確かに優れた剣士ではあるが、それはこの地形条件であったからこそ。
pages.jaRuby:

アサシンは確かに優れた剣士ではあるが、それはこの地形条件であったからこそ。
pages.en:
“Wh—”

For Assassin, abandoning the high ground is equivalent to accepting defeat.

He is unquestionably an exceptional swordsman, but only these conditions have allowed him to hold Saber at bay.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“What?”
To relinquish his advantage of being overhead is the same as losing for Assassin.
Assassin is certainly a skilled swordsman, but that is only with the conditions of these geographical features.

それはアサシンとて承知の筈。
だというのに、何故

pages.en:
On equal footing, Saber could knock the long blade aside in a single stroke and take his head before he recovered.

Assassin must know that.

Then why—?
pages.mirrorMoon:
If they are to fight on the same level, it is possible for Saber to repel Assassin’s attack and slash his neck.
But Assassin would know this as well.
So why?

pages.ja:
「構えよ。でなければ死ぬぞ、セイバー」
さらりとしたその声に、セイバーの直感が反応した。
それは事実だ。
アサシンが下りて来た事は、自分にとって有利な事などではない。
幾多の戦いを駆け抜けてきた直感が、自らの過ちを警告する。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Take your stance. Otherwise, you will die, Saber.”

His mild voice sets Saber's instinct alight.

—He speaks the truth.

Assassin's descent has not placed her at an advantage.

The intuition honed across countless battles warns her of her mistake.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Be ready. Or you will die, Saber.”
Saber’s instincts react to that voice.
He’s telling the truth.
It is not advantageous at all for Saber that Assassin has come down.
The instincts that have got her through numerous battles warn her of her misunderstanding.

！

“Kh—!”

She raises the invisible sword on instinct.

There is no time to hesitate.

She need only strike before Assassin can swing his long blade—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ku!”
She readies her sword at once.
There is no time to hesitate.
She only has to attack with her sword before Assassin swings his longsword!

この戦いが始まって以来、見せた事もない剣士の構え。

pages.en:
“Hh—”

Less than three meters separate them.

And then—

For the first time since their battle began, the swordsman assumes a stance.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Fu”
There’s about three meters of distance between them.
With Saber trying to charge in, Assassin stands ready.
That…
…Is a stance that the swordsman has not yet shown in this battle.

pages.ja:

」

もはや長刀は意味をなさない。

だが。

pages.en:
“Secret sword——”

Saber surges forward.

The long blade has lost its purpose. Once she enters his reach, its very length will betray him.

But—

“——Tsubame Gaeshi.”

No such conventional law exists before this swordsman.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Secret technique”
Saber charges in.
The longsword is useless now.
As long as she’s inside its range, its length will backfire.
But.
“Tsubame-Gaeshi”
Such logic does not exist with this swordsman.

！

Lightning falls.

A demonic stroke descends in a straight line, faster even than Saber's sword—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
The lightning strikes.
An evil strike that attacks with speed overwhelming Saber!

pages.en:
“——!”

But Saber is more than capable of defending against a blow of that degree.

She tears her rising blade back into a guard and repels Assassin's full-force strike…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
But it is not as if Saber cannot block such an attack.
She moves her attacking sword into defense, and she repels Assassin’s full-power attack…!

pages.en:
“I have you…!”

Even Assassin must leave an opening after having such a blow deflected.

In that interval of less than a second, Saber begins to sweep her sword through his abdomen.

“————Ah.”

In that instant, trusting nothing but her instincts, Saber throws her body down the stone steps.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Got it…!”
Even Assassin will have an opening if that attack is repelled.
In the small instant where she tries to slice Assassin’s stomach…
“Ah”
In that instant, Saber trusts her instincts and rolls down the stone steps.

pages.ja:
逃げるように転がり落ちる。

pages.en:
She tumbles away as though fleeing.

There is no attempt to break her fall.

Saber simply hurls herself downward and rolls without slowing her momentum.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She rolls down as if fleeing.
She doesn’t even soften her landing.
Saber spins her body frantically and rolls down the stairs without killing her speed.

pages.ja:

！」

pages.en:
“Kh—!”

Saber stops her fall and forces herself upright.

She looks up to find only the long-bladed swordsman, standing perfectly composed.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ku!”
Saber stops rolling and stands back up.
She stares at the swordsman standing calmly.

pages.ja: 「ほう。躱したか我が秘剣。さすがはセイバー、燕などとは格が違う」
pages.jaRuby: 「ほう。躱したか我が秘剣。さすがはセイバー、燕などとは格が違う」
pages.en: “Oh? You escaped my hidden sword. As expected of Saber—you are of another order than any swallow.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Oh. You have dodged my secret technique. As expected of Saber, you are unlike the swallow.”

pages.ja:

“—Impossible. That attack… Could it truly have…?”

“It is no great feat. Once, on a whim, I thought to cut down a swallow. I merely acquired the skill in pursuit of that thought.”

The long blade rises slightly, retracing the motion of the demonic sword that made Saber recoil.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I do not believe it. That cannot be…”
“No, it is nothing much. It is just something I thought of when considering how to hit swallows.”
He raises his longsword a little.
As ifto trace the movement of the technique that inspired fear in Saber.

pages.ja:
「見えるかセイバー。
燕はな、風を受けて刀を避ける。速かろうが遅かろうが関係はない。どのような刀であろうと、大気を震わさずには振れぬであろう？ 連中はその震えを感じ取り、飛ぶ方向を変えるのだ。
故に、どのような一撃であれ燕を断つ事はできなかった。所詮刀など一本線にすぎぬ。縦横に空を行く燕を捕らえられぬは道理よな」
pages.jaRuby:
「見えるかセイバー。

pages.en:
“Can you see it, Saber?

“A swallow rides the wind to evade the blade. Speed makes no difference. No sword can be swung without disturbing the air, and the creatures feel that disturbance and alter their flight.

“Thus no single stroke could ever cut one down. A sword is only a line, after all. Naturally it cannot capture a swallow that travels through the sky in every direction.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Can you see it, Saber?
Swallows avoid the sword by feeling the wind. It does not matter how fast your sword is. You cannot swing a sword without shaking the air, correct? The swallows feel this shaking and change their direction of flight.
So no one could kill the swallows with one blow, no matter what kind of blow it was. A sword is only a straight line after all. It is only natural for it to be unable to apprehend the swallow, which can move vertically and horizontally.”

pages.ja:
「ならば逃げ道を囲めばいいだけのこと。
一の太刀で燕を襲い、風を読んで避ける燕の逃げ道を続く二の太刀で取り囲む。
しかし連中は素早くてな。この長刀ではまず二の太刀が間に合わん。事を成したければ一息の内、ほぼ同時に行わなければならなかったが、そのような真似は人の業ではない。
叶う事などあるまいと承知したものだが
」
pages.jaRuby:
「ならば逃げ道を囲めばいいだけのこと。
一の太刀で燕を襲い、風を読んで避ける燕の逃げ道を続く二の太刀で取り囲む。
しかし連中は素早くてな。この長刀ではまず二の太刀が間に合わん。事を成したければ一息の内、ほぼ同時に行わなければならなかったが、そのような真似は人の業ではない。

」
pages.en:
“Then one need only surround every path of escape.

“The first blade attacks the swallow. The second encloses the route by which it evades after reading the wind.

“But they are swift creatures. With this long blade, the second stroke could never arrive in time. To succeed, both had to be completed within a single breath—almost simultaneously. Such a feat lies beyond human ability.

“I understood that it could never be done—”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Thus you only have to surround its escape route.
Use one blow to attack the swallow and use your second blow to catch the escaping swallow as it reads the wind.
But they are fast. The second blow cannot come in time with this longsword. If I wanted to get the swallows, I would have to do both attacks at about the same time. But such a thing is beyond human abilities.
I accepted such a thing was impossible, but”

pages.ja:
「
生憎と、他にやる事もなかったのでな。
一念鬼神に通じると言うが、気が付けばこの通りよ。
燕を断つという下らぬ思いつきは、複数の太刀筋で牢獄を作り上げる秘剣となった」
pages.jaRuby:
「

pages.en:
“—But unfortunately, I had nothing else with which to occupy myself.

“They say a single-minded will can reach even gods and demons. By the time I took notice, this was the result.

“A foolish desire to cut down a swallow had become a secret sword that constructs a prison from multiple paths of steel.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Unfortunately, I had nothing else to do.
They say determination is key to success, but when I noticed, it was like this.
A worthless idea to kill a swallow became a secret technique that creates a prison with many slashes.”

pages.ja:

違う。
今の剣はそんな簡単なモノではない。

二つの刃はまったくの同時だった。
アサシン

pages.en:
As he speaks so casually, Saber rejects his account in silence.

No.

That sword was nothing so simple.

Almost simultaneous? Impossible.

The two blades had been perfectly simultaneous.

For that single instant, Assassin—Sasaki Kojirou—had unquestionably possessed two swords.
pages.mirrorMoon:
In her mind, Saber disagrees with Assassin’s words.
It’s wrong.
That technique is not as simple as that.
About the same time? No.
The two blows came at exactly the same time.
Assassin’sSasaki Kojirou’s longsword doubled its existence for just that instant.

pages.ja:
「……多重次元屈折現象……なんの魔術も使わず、ただ剣技だけで、宝具の域に達したサーヴァント
」
驚嘆すべきはまさにそれだ。
今の一撃ではっきりと判った。
佐々木小次郎には、英霊が持つ“宝具”などない。
有るのはただ、神域に達した力量による魔剣のみ。
あろうことか
この男は人の身でありながら、宝具で武装した英霊と互角なのだ

！
pages.en:
“…Kischur Zelretch—a multidimensional refraction… Without using any magecraft, through swordsmanship alone, this Servant has reached the realm of a Noble Phantasm—”

That was the true marvel.

The exchange had made one fact plain: Sasaki Kojirou possessed no Noble Phantasm of the kind carried by Heroic Spirits.

He had only a demonic sword, born of skill that had entered the realm of the divine.

Against all reason, this man—while remaining human—could stand as an equal against Heroic Spirits armed with Noble Phantasms…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Multi-dimensional refraction phenomenon… Kischur Zelretch… A Servant that has reached the level of a Noble Phantasm with mere skill”
That fact is what should be admired.
That one blow made it clear.
Sasaki Kojirou does not have a Noble Phantasm like heroic spirits have.
He has only his demonic technique, made possible by his god-like skill.
It is impossiblebut this mere human is equal to heroic spirits armed with Noble Phantasms!

「だが足場が悪かったな。燕返しの軌跡は本来三つ。もうわずかに広ければ、横の一撃も加えられたのだが」
「……そうでしょうね。そうでなければ不完全です。
全てが同時であるなら、円の軌跡はどうしても遅くなる。それを補うために、横方向への離脱を阻む払いがある筈だ」

pages.en:
“The footing betrayed me. Tsubame Gaeshi properly has three paths. With a little more room, I would have added the horizontal stroke.”

“…Naturally. Otherwise the technique is incomplete.

“If every blade is simultaneous, the second must travel in an arc and will inevitably arrive later. A third blade—a horizontal sweep to prevent escape to the side—would compensate for that delay.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But the foothold was bad. The Tsubame-Gaeshi originally has three slashes. If this place were a bit wider, I could have added the horizontal slash as well.”
“…I would assume so. It would not be effective without that.
If everything is to happen at the same time, the second blow has to be slower. To compensate for that, there should be a third horizontal attack, to prevent the opponent from dodging sideways.”

pages.ja:
「いい呑みこみの早さだ。だからこそ我が秘剣を躱したか。
く、素晴らしいぞセイバー……！
このような俗世に呼び出された我が身を呪ったが、それも今宵まで。生前では叶わなかった立ち会い、我が秘剣を存分に振舞える殺し合いが出来るのならば、呼び出された甲斐があるというもの
」

く、素晴らしいぞセイバー……！

pages.en:
“Quick to understand. That must be why you escaped my hidden sword.

“—Ha. Magnificent, Saber…!

“I cursed the fate that summoned me into this vulgar age—but only until tonight. If I may enjoy the contest denied me in life—a duel to the death in which I can wield my hidden sword without restraint—then being summoned was worthwhile after all—”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You catch on quickly. That must be why you were able to avoid my secret technique.
Hah, you are wonderful, Saber.
I have cursed myself for being summoned in this world, but that will end tonight. If I am able to battle someone I can fully use my secret attacks on, it is well worth being summoned”

pages.ja:
長刀を構え直し、石段を下るアサシン。
狙うはセイバーの首か。
今一度あの秘剣を躱す自信など、セイバーにはない。
ランサーのゲイボルク同様、アサシンの燕返しは出させてはいけないモノだ。

pages.en:
Assassin resets his long blade and descends the stairs.

Is his target Saber's neck?

She has no confidence that she can evade his hidden sword a second time.

Like Lancer's Gae Bolg, Assassin's Tsubame Gaeshi is an attack that must never be allowed to begin.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Assassin readies his sword once again and comes down the stairs.
He must be after Saber’s neck.
Saber is not confident if she will be able to avoid that secret technique again.
Like Lancer’s Gae Bolg, Assassin’s Tsubame-Gaeshi is something that cannot be allowed to begin.

pages.ja:

あるとすれば、出させない事それ一点。

pages.en:
No—Gae Bolg can be answered once one knows that it will invariably seek the heart. Assassin's hidden sword remains all but impossible to evade even with complete knowledge of it.

There is only one answer: prevent him from using it.

To win, she must deliver her strongest blow before Assassin can unleash that technique—
pages.mirrorMoon:
No, unlike Gae Bolg, that allows you to find a countermeasure once you find out it will go for the heart, there are no possible counters for Assassin’s secret technique even when you know about it.
If there is a countermeasure, it is only not to let him use it.
To beat it, she must attack him with her strongest blow before Assassin uses that technique

pages.ja:
「……なるほど。確かに、手加減など許される相手ではなかったようだ」
両手を下段に。
視えない剣を地に突きつけるように下げ、セイバーは歩み寄るアサシンを睨む。
「ほう……？ そうか、ようやくその気になったかセイバー」
pages.jaRuby:
「……なるほど。確かに、手加減など許される相手ではなかったようだ」

「ほう……？ そうか、ようやくその気になったかセイバー」
pages.en:
“…I see. It seems you truly are not an opponent I can afford to hold back against.”

She lowers both hands.

Holding the invisible sword as though its point were planted in the earth, Saber glares at the approaching Assassin.

“Oh…? I see. At last you have resolved yourself, Saber.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I see. Certainly, you are not someone I can go easy on.”
She lowers her arms.
She lowers her sword as if to stick it into the ground. She glares at Assassin, who is approaching her.
“Hm…? So you are finally ready to do so?”

pages.ja:
階段を下りる体を止め、今一度必殺の構えをとるアサシン。
それを凛と見据え、
「
不満がないのはこちらも同じだ。
我が一撃、受けきれるかアサシンのサーヴァント……！」
セイバーは自らの枷を解いた。

pages.en:
Assassin stops his descent and once more assumes his killing stance.

Saber meets his gaze without flinching.

“—Then neither of us has anything to complain about.

“Can you withstand my blow, Servant of the Assassin class…!?”

Saber releases the restraint upon herself.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Assassin stops descending the steps and readies himself for a certain kill.
Saber looks at him bravely.
“I too have no complaints.
Will you be able to take my attack, Servant Assassin…!?”
Saber releases her own restraints.

pages.ja:
大気が震える。
剣は彼女の意思に呼応するかのように、大量の風を吐き出した。
pages.jaRuby:

剣は彼女の意思に呼応するかのように、大量の風を吐き出した。
pages.en:
The air trembles.

As though answering her will, the sword exhales an immense volume of wind.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The air shakes.
As if acting in response to her will, the sword erupts with a massive amount of wind.

pages.ja:

！」
わずかに後退するアサシン。
セイバーから放たれる風圧は尋常ではない。
アサシンばかりか、太く堅固な山門の木々さえも震え、軋んでいる。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Ngh—!”

Assassin takes a slight step backward.

The pressure pouring from Saber is monstrous.

Not only Assassin, but even the thick, sturdy timbers of the temple gate shudder and groan.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Mm!”
Assassin retreats a bit.
The wind pressure released from Saber is extraordinary.
Not only Assassin, but even the large firm trees of the forest are shaking and creaking.

pages.ja:
それは、爆発に近い風の流れだった。
密閉されていた大気が解放され、四方に吹き荒ぶ。
人間の一人や二人などたやすく吹き飛ばす烈風は、セイバーの剣から放出されている。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
The flow of wind is closer to an explosion.

Air held under confinement bursts free and rages in every direction.

The gale could easily sweep away one or two human beings, and it is pouring from Saber's sword.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It is a flow of wind like an explosion.
The trapped air is released and explodes outward.
This raging wind that would easily blow away a normal person is coming out from Saber’s sword.

pages.ja:
それが彼女の剣の力。
風王結界とは、その名の通り風を封じた剣である。
圧縮された風を纏う剣は、光の屈折角度を変貌させ剣を透明に見せていた。
その風を解放すればこのような現象が起こる。
解き放たれた空気は逃げ場を求め、無秩序に周囲に発散する。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
That is the power of her sword.

Invisible Air—the wind king's barrier—is precisely what its title suggests: a sword that imprisons the wind.

The compressed air wrapped around the blade alters the refraction of light, rendering the sword transparent.

When that air is released, this is the result. The liberated current seeks escape and erupts chaotically in every direction.
pages.mirrorMoon:
That is the power of her sword.
“Invisible Air” is a sword that has wind sealed in it.
The sword that covers itself in compressed wind changes the refraction of light to make it look invisible.
So this phenomenon occurs once the wind is released.
The released wind seeks escape and emits itself chaotically into the surroundings.

pages.ja:
その合間。
吹き荒ぶ風を自在に操る事が、彼女の剣にかけられた戒めの魔術である。
膨大な魔力を持つセイバーならば、おそらくは数分は結界を維持し得るだろう。
その証拠に、これだけの風を解放していながら、未だ彼女の剣は透明のままだった。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
—And in the interval before it disperses, the binding magecraft laid upon her sword allows her to command the raging wind at will.

With Saber's enormous reserves of magical energy, she could likely maintain the barrier for several minutes.

The proof lies before them: despite releasing so much wind, her sword remains invisible.
pages.mirrorMoon:
In that instant.
It is the commanding magic of the sword that allows her to freely manipulate the raging wind.
With Saber possessing incredible amounts of magical energy, she should be able to hold this boundary field for a few minutes.
As proof, her sword is still invisible even though she has already released this much wind.

」

The violence of the wind does not subside.

The gale pouring from Saber's sword rears like a serpent, poised to swallow Assassin whole.
